        /// <summary>

        /// <returns>A <see cref="Task"/> representing the asynchronous operation.</returns>

            => source.SaveAsync(stream, encoder ?? source.Configuration.ImageFormatsManager.GetEncoder(global::Img.Formats.Gif.GifFormat.Instance), cancellationToken);
